Strategy: Smooth sweet-spot residual. Score each bin by the post-placement residual minus a decaying bonus that fades as the residual grows, so the score peaks near a residual of about twenty rather than at zero. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit is exact while another bin leaves a moderate gap. It may help by preserving bins that can still hold another item, but may fail if the moderate gaps it creates are never filled.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) - 1000.0 / ((r - item) + 10.0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Smooth sweet-spot residual: score peaks near residual ~22, preserving bins that fit another item.
